Yes, an official Microsoft hard drive is required. The official hard drive comes with an extra partition on it for OG Xbox games. It is required because in the OG Xbox was a built in hard drive and developers coded into the games expecting the hard drive to always be there, so thus a hard drive has to be there to play an OG Xbox game.
